A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same MEAP research work. All 17 pages, including Appendices A–B, equations, figures and tables, are readable and support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v2 reports original MEAP-versus-NTP pretraining and fine-tuning experiments, benchmark results, ablations and attention analyses in Sections 4–6 and Appendix A.

after.justification: v3 retains these original experimental outcomes, including retrieval accuracy, reasoning results, hallucination evaluations and appendix analyses.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains the same random-masking pretraining procedure, duplicated-sequence fine-tuning procedure, objectives and masking ratios. No algorithm or model component changes.

E1.justification: Training data and evaluated task coverage are unchanged, including commonsense benchmarks, Needle-in-a-Haystack, multi-document QA, M-RS and XSum/MultiNews/WikiSum summarization.

E2.justification: NTP remains the comparator in the corresponding experiments. The cross-model comparisons and masking-strategy comparison in Table 15 retain the same participating methods.

E3.justification: Model configurations, training budgets, context lengths, metrics and sample sizes are unchanged. Section 4.2.3 still compares two MEAP epochs with four NTP epochs.

E4.justification: Both retain the same training-efficiency analysis, attention analyses, masking-ratio and masking-strategy ablations, loss curves and supplementary attention examples in Appendix A.

E5.justification: The 500-sequence attention analysis and Table 10's t-statistics and p-values are unchanged. No repeated-run, seed or uncertainty-reporting information is added or revised.

E6.justification: Numerical results and plotted findings match throughout the main text and appendices. For example, Table 2 retains 98.2% MEAP versus 87.1% NTP accuracy at 200B tokens, and Table 8 retains every position-specific result.

T1.justification: Section 3's probability and loss formulations and Section 5.1's attention-score decay and variance-increase definitions are unchanged. No assumptions, derivations or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims about retrieval, long-context reasoning, data efficiency and compatibility with existing decoder-only models.

C2.justification: The interpretation of masking as improving attention distinguishability and focus on relevant tokens is unchanged. The fine-tuning overhead discussion and applicability qualifications are also retained.

D1.justification: The abstract changes the code repository address and hyperlink target from scitix/MEAP to CharlieZhuang-Code/MEAP on GitHub. Implementation details, hyperparameters and evaluation prompts, including Appendices A–B, remain unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2, the cited works and the reference list are unchanged, as is the positioning relative to MLM, NTP and unified training approaches.

P1.justification: Textual updates are limited to the code-link text and arXiv version/date stamp. The title, authors, substantive prose, terminology and section organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1–7 and Tables 1–19 retain their displays, captions, structure and placement. Rendered-page comparison establishes no figure, table or page-layout revision.

improvement.justification: v3 preserves the scientific content, empirical evidence, appendix material and readability of v2. The repository-address and version-stamp updates do not resolve a documented paper deficiency; the PDFs establish no change in code contents or availability that would support an overall quality gain or loss.
